SECTION 3: SCOPE (A) This ordinance shall apply to the manufacture, transportation, and sale of malt beverages, wine, and distilled spirits on any premises or establishment within the City. Such activities shall also be governed by any and all applicable state laws, regulations, and procedures as well as the requirements for a license issued by the ABC Board. The provisions of this Ordinance shall apply to all persons, firms, companies, corporations, other entities, licensees, premises, and establishments within the City to the fullest extent such application is delegated to the City, or otherwise authorized, by the provisions of KRS Ch. 241 through 244.
